_comment: Exact products aggregated per oil + daily scrape targets. Reliable/established UK sellers only (small shops & loss-leaders excluded). UK prices only. One fixed pack size per oil (sunflower/rapeseed/soybean 20L, palm & beef dripping 12.5kg, olive EV 5L). Prices are the single standalone pack price incl. any current discount (a reliable shop dropping price is the signal); GBP/tonne computed downstream.
